about: Fog volume presets: named sets of a fog volume's fields (lighting/README.md, 'Fog volumes'). A volume with preset=<id> takes every field it does not write from its preset, so editing a preset here (or with the editor's Save as preset) updates every volume using it. Fields: shape, size, density, edge, color, fill, noise, sim, sim_strength, sim_recover, sim_footprint, sim_trail, sim_wind, detail, sim_swirl, shadow, disturb_player, disturb_actors, disturb_attacks, disturb_spells (-1: the global setting fog_disturb_*). Position, yaw, name and enabled are the volume's own.

ankle_mist.name: Ankle mist
ankle_mist.why: A thin sheet of mist at the feet that the characters wade through: soft holes, short wakes

knee_fog.name: Knee fog
knee_fog.why: Mist up to the knees: parts more slowly, keeps its wake a little longer

forest_floor.name: Forest floor
forest_floor.why: Snowfly Forest's clearings: cold low mist with billows that curl around Ashley's legs and darken in their dense parts, drifting with the wind

rolling_fog.name: Rolling fog
rolling_fog.why: Thick fog banks to the knees that roll and curl into eddies behind whoever walks through, lit rims and dark cores

thick_smoke.name: Thick smoke
thick_smoke.why: Heavy grey smoke (a brazier, a burnt room): billowing, strongly self-shadowed, slow to settle; raise the room's haze_max_opacity for it to read as solid

sewer_steam.name: Sewer steam
sewer_steam.why: The Undercity's damp halls: a greenish low steam that closes quickly behind you

still_pool.name: Still pool
still_pool.why: Heavy, windless mist in a hollow: what is parted stays parted for a while

doorway_draft.name: Doorway draft
doorway_draft.why: A faint wisp through a doorway or a window (not interactive: nobody walks in it)
